skillbooksstats:handbook-text:
Just like crafting knowledge, an aptitude for endurance, speed, or any other trait of the body can be found rather than earned the hard way. These "stat books" work the same as their crafting-trait cousins: read one to permanently pick up whatever trait it holds.

A book that no longer holds any interest can be salvaged for its leather binding with a simple knife. Alternatively, if a book's particular knowledge isn't what you were hoping for, hold it alongside a temporal gear in your other hand and read as normal -- the gear unravels and reweaves it into an entirely different stat book, though what knowledge you'll uncover next is left to chance.
